scope: Owned Reservoir Scope rehearsal only. No Being process, workspace or service accessed. No local endpoint contacted, model copied, downloaded or launched by this selection task.

selectedModel.selectionReason: Modest cached 4B family candidate for a bounded plain-prose journal check; preserves cached identity and avoids a download.
selectedModel.blobAvailability: Not inspected: manifest only. Every referenced ordinary blob must pass exact size and digest validation before a private copy.
selectedModel.registryDifference: Current registry tag differs from cached manifest; no pull, update or substitution authorized.

installedSoftware.versionSource: Application Info.plist only; binary not executed or hashed by selection task.

startupAudit.basis: Read-only review of official v0.40.3 source plus installed public app metadata and conventional key/config existence/permissions. This is conditional source evidence, not runtime proof or an OS sandbox.
expectedNoGlobalOllamaWritesConditions: Existing ordinary private key remains present: initializeKeypair therefore does not create private/public keys. Abort if the precondition changes.
server.json is read by configuration loading, not created by the reviewed serve path.
OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 prevents recommendation refresh/persistence; an existing conventional recommendation cache may still be read.
All selected model files are private copies under OLLAMA_MODELS because startup model maintenance can write there even with OLLAMA_NOPRUNE=1.

proposedLaunch.mustWaitFor: Root completes the frozen minimized reliability run and explicitly begins this owned rehearsal; never before 2026-10-13T18:39:18.845510Z.
proposedLaunch.environmentPolicy: Child-only environment. Remove inherited OLLAMA_* and HTTP proxy overrides before applying this allowlist; preserve HOME unchanged. Do not use launchctl, the GUI launcher, ollama run/pull/list/stop, or an existing endpoint.

modelCopyLayout.blobRelativePathRule: blobs/<digest with colon replaced by hyphen>
modelCopyLayout.copyMethod: Ordinary private copy or filesystem clone with independent writes; no symlinks or hard links to shared cache.
modelCopyLayout.onMissingOrMismatch: Abort; do not pull or substitute.

proposedLaunch.endpointDiscovery: Read the actual nonzero loopback listener port from this owned process log; only then configure the app endpoint. No default-service discovery or endpoint scan.
proposedLaunch.processOwnership: Use a new process session/group (e.g. Popen(start_new_session=True)), retain PID/start identity/executable hash/PGID and direct child ownership evidence. Bundled runner is an owned child and normally inherits that group on Darwin.
proposedLaunch.cleanup: Supervise for at most about 900 seconds. Signal only the still-verified owned PID/process group; wait and reap; any escalation stays within that verified group. Never broad pkill/killall or default-service stop.

requestBounds.attemptBudgetMeaning: Prepared provider attempts, including any explicit retries. This rehearsal proposes no retry.
requestBounds.journalGoal: Up to four accepted and saved journals at steps 30/60/90/120, each with a following application boundary through step 121, if successful. Fewer accepted journals remain an observed outcome.
requestBounds.durationBoundary: Already-dispatched generation may settle within its 60-second request deadline after the app duration boundary; no automatic follow-up or numerical application beyond a reached budget.

resourceQualification.hostMemorySource: Parent-provided host description; not remeasured here.
resourceQualification.headroomMeaning: Prospective cushion for the private copy and owned temporary/cache/log files, not an enforced Ollama quota or a measured requirement.
resourceQualification.warning: Parallelism/context limits are controls, not a proven peak-memory or response-quality bound. Temperature zero does not guarantee bit-identical output across builds/hardware.

requiredBeforeLaunch: Recheck installed executable and helper identity; hash executable for the new run receipt without launching it for version discovery.
Recheck conventional key/public-key/server.json existence, types and identities privately; retain before/after identity evidence without key contents. Abort if a missing key would be created.
Validate all five referenced blobs against manifest sizes/digests; make only the selected private cache copy and verify it.
Record free space and exact process ownership before the first app request.
requiredAfterRun: Cancel or settle the owned app request and retain the actual outcome; no manufactured success.
Stop and reap only the owned service/process group.
Verify conventional key/config identity unchanged and record any unexpected startup writes.
Retain exact owned model/manifest, service/app identities, request outcomes and resource observations; keep local model results separate from the prior synthetic reliability run.

sources.supports: Current public tag availability; not the cached manifest identity.
Host, models directory, cloud, context, concurrency and keep-alive settings.
Apple Metal support; not a measured resource claim.
Direct serve path; initializeKeypair writes only if conventional private key is absent; listen uses configured host.
Port zero accepted; OLLAMA_MODELS and OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD; conventional server.json read path.
Startup model-directory maintenance; actual listener address; owned runner shutdown.
Existing conventional recommendation cache may be read; NO_CLOUD prevents refresh and persistence.
Model-show process cache and cloud hydration guard.
Request-body logging disabled unless explicitly enabled.
Owned local llama-server child, loopback binding, offline flag and configured model path.
Darwin child SysProcAttr does not assign another process group.
Local bundled helper search; no download proposed.
